Florashroom Petarie
Bwah!! *spit*\n...Ow? Where are we now??
We were in the town called Akaku, right?\nWas it... a dream?
That means, you and I had the same dream?\nHow disg...
...Looks like it wasn't a dream.
A red flower to value the brave is found\non your chest...
Aggghhh!!
I got nothing AGAAAAAIN!
Florashroom Petarie
Whoa?! N-No! S-Stop it!!
I knew they were Technista's Golems...\nHey, what are you doing?!\nYou can break them easily, right?
...Yes. They're not shaped like a human but they\nare golems. Self-propelled golems.\nTake care of them, now!
Whoa! Whoa! W-What's going on?!\nHey, what're you doing?!\nWe've gotta run!!
That was close...\nI wonder why there were so many golems in such\na place...
...For now, let's go back and report it to the\nKing.
Florashroom Petarie
Hey, what are you?\nSoldiers of Lyark Technista or something?!
Argk! My magic isn't enough!!
Vecutura Punctum!
Ho ho, great! It's my turn...\nFireeee!!
Wow! Amazing!!
You can take care of the rest, right?\nFInish 'em!
Florashroom Petarie
You saved our lives. Thanks.\nBut why are you in such a place?
What are you saying?\nIt's the land of Pax Technista.\nWe've just come back for the first time in a while.
Aha...\nApparently you guys belong to the Pax faction.
I knew it...
W-What's this?!\nIs it human? Golem?
Demi Machina...An artificial monster made of human.\nHalf of the body is replaced with magic organs.\nThe brain's taken out & it just follows programs.
They're weapons made of human bodies, so...\nthe cost is cheaper than metal golems.
Such inhumane weapons...
Florashroom Petarie
It must be Lyark...
W-What kind of people are they...
Whoa?!
...The power source seems to have exploded.\nIt doesn't look like it was damaged,\nnormally it'd explode when defeated...
Ahhh, no trace was left behind.\nI wanted to check the power source...
By the way, you're awesome!\nYou can control a golem.
I heard that Humes can't really use magic, so\nI thought you were a mechanic or repairman.
I-It's not my power.\nIt's thanks to the device on the magic book...
There is a strange plate-like device on the\nmagic book...
Oh! Now you noticed my invention!
This device automatically casts the spells written\nin magic books. Fantastic, huh?
Fantastic! People who don't have magic power can\nnow cast spells!
Yeah! York can't use magic at all,\nbut look at him!
Ohhh, even though he doesn't have magic power...
Hm? What's wrong?
Arrrggghhhh!!
What happened to him?
I have no idea...
You guys are sick...
Oh, he dropped such an important note...\nI told him many times not to just place notes\nbetween the pages, but file them instead...
Oh, he's using very rare paper notes.
York has a thing about notes.\nIt has to be this paper to take notes...
Aha...
Demi Machinas might appear again.\nWe should build up defense here for a while.
Why not visit Einklang beyond here? It's our town.\nYou'll see lots of things you've never seen.
Alright, we'll go there.\nThanks for saving us.
EVENT BATTLE\nDefeat the Masked Men!!
Florashroom Petarie
Alright, let's see...\nDo you see anything strange?
Not really...
Oh?
Right~? There shouldn't be many suspicious people\naround here. Welp, let's head back for now!
Huh? What's wrong?\nWhat? You think you saw someone?
I don't see anyone though.\nMaybe it was just your imagination?\nWelp, let's head back for now!
Florashroom Petarie
Tch, why are they here...?\nDon't tell me they found out about our plan this\ntime.
The Taste of Autumn campaign is happening now!\nHere you can fight against a [ffff64]special boss tailored\nfor party battle[ffffff]!
